profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Meta
profile.summary:
With over three years of backend microservice development experience, I bring expertise in Node.js, TypeScript, and scalable backend architecture. At CVS Health, I played a key role in building and enhancing systems that serve over 12 million users. I led the architecture and integration of event-driven SMS and push notifications into a previously email-centric platform, broadening communication channels. Additionally, I designed and built APIs and microservices to process complex, regulated health data and restructured fragmented logging to enable comprehensive monitoring, significantly improving site reliability.

Alongside my technical skills, I have experience in project management, coordinating with stakeholders and team to meet project timelines and goals. This background enhances my ability to drive projects to completion and ensure that technical and business objectives align effectively.

Languages, Frameworks, Libraries: Typescript, Javascript, SQL, Nest.js, Express, React, Angular
Backend & Databases: Node.js, SQL (MySQL, PostgresSQL), NoSQL (MongoDB), Kafka, Google Pub/Sub, REST APIs
DevOps & CI/CD: Git, Kubernetes, Docker, Jenkins, CircleCI, Harness CD, Splunk
Testing & QA: Jest, CucumberJS, Playwright

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II (Backend)
positions.description:
- Backend engineer developing Node.js microservices for Digital Notifications and CVS Health Dashboard with 12M+ users
- Architected and implemented SMS and push notification channels on previously email-only system
- Overhauled fragmented logging across microservices enabling effective system monitoring and decreased incident resolution time
- Led API design in close collaboration with Product and Legal to process dense health data (following FHIR standards)
- Mentored new Engineers, Interns, and team members transitioning from frontend to backend
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Software Design · Event Driven Programming · REST APIs · API Development

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Low-level startup in the real estate industry providing property management software largely tailored toward apartment complexes.

- Created responsive design with React and utilized Custom React Hooks for state management

- Hosted Postgresql database with AWS RDS to store user and lease data for analytics

- Collaborated in schema creation to ensure comprehensive data collection for future scaling

- Held daily stand up meetings and weekly sprint meetings to communicate progress and blockers

- Built front and back-end RESTful API to register users, handle user sessions, validate forms, etc

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
C2C application where users lease or rent private parking spaces to simplify parking in urban areas

- Set up MySQL database and schema to support MVC architecture and relational data

- Researched and implemented Google Maps API with user geolocation as application’s core UI

- Created CRUD routes from back-end to display database data on Google Maps on client side

- Built logic testing scripts using Mocha/Chai and Travis-CI to ensure application stability

positions.title: Project Engineer
positions.description:
- Recognized regionally as leader in technology after developing drone solutions to enhance documentation, project planning, and quantity tracking saving a project over $250k in claims

- Managed teams of 10+ people and collaborated with stakeholders to successfully build $35,000,000 jobs and scopes of work over $6,000,000

- Taught construction GPS utilization and 3D site modeling to increase productivity by 25% and reduce overhead

positions.title: Structural Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Perform structural evaluation, analysis, and design

- Assist in developing engineering reports

- Aid drafting projects in AutoCAD

positions.title: Maintenence Intern
positions.description:
- Assist development and implementation of maintenance strategies to optimize/integrate maintenance and operational requirements

- Perform entry to mid-level assignments in support of both maintenance and capital improvement projects

positions.title: Server
positions.description: Efficiently serve customers while maintaining good relations, teamwork in belief of core philosophy of authenticity, integrity, and tradition at the Northwest’s first Associazione Verace Pizza Napoletana distinguished restaurant.

volunteerExperiences.description: Planned, coordinated, and managed the volunteer construction of a couple large playground structures for Housing Hope at Twin Lakes, WA. This playground is now an integral part of the low income housing development that is intended to reduce homelessness and poverty for residents of Snohomish.
